scope: Equal-depth verification for a former municipal house now combining government and culture, a Barranco corridor entering authorized public-realm works, and a protected private modern house whose street threshold must carry the image.

sources.supports: Repeated 2026 ordinary and extraordinary council sessions occur in the Palacio Municipal y de la Cultura, confirming active civic use.
A free 2026 exhibition occupied the palace galleries with published access; it is completed evidence, not a current show window.

sources.publisher: Bienal Panamericana de Arquitectura de Quito
sources.supports: Professional project record documents the 1934 Casa Consistorial and its adaptive conversion within the Olivar cultural system.
March 2026 sector authorization permits Stage I public-space tourism improvements at Alameda Sáenz Peña; authorization does not prove construction completion or current access.
Official monumental-zone survey records building alignments, heights, ages and repeatable street camera positions along Sáenz Peña.
Official creative-district guide documents galleries, cultural businesses and visitor activity across Sáenz Peña and Domeyer; current operator status requires verification.
Documents the 1938 house, façade/entry/plan, current residential use, unevaluated condition and stated demolition threat.
Municipal tourism/heritage plan lists the house at Av. Aviación 500 as a national monument under RDN 290-96/INC dated 1996.
Current municipal heritage page identifies the house and street address as a district cultural asset; it does not prove public access or 2026 condition.

contradictions: The restored 1934 Casa Consistorial supports both municipal deliberation and cultural display, but those uses may occupy different rooms/times and cannot be forced into one frame.
A completed free exhibition proves public gallery capacity, not current exhibition access or photography permission.
Council registration/QR procedures show controlled civic access; exterior openness does not imply walk-in interior entry.
composition_questions: Can an Olivar approach, restored threshold and real council/gallery arrival show the building switching between civic authority and cultural access?
Which security desk, banner, parked vehicle, exhibition furniture or tree overlap hides the threshold hierarchy?
Does a permitted interior/exterior position reveal shared spatial order between deliberation and display, or must one use be selected and the dual claim killed?

source_truth.answer: The restored 1934 Casa Consistorial at Los Incas 270 operates in 2026 as Palacio Municipal y de la Cultura, hosting repeated council sessions and cultural programs.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A municipal house organized representative entry, offices and civic rooms; restoration adapted those rooms and their Olivar edge into cultural equipment while retaining institutional hierarchy.

current_life.answer: Councillors, registered participants, staff, visitors and exhibition audiences enter, deliberate, view and depart; named shows are completed and session access remains controlled.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Register, arrive, enter, deliberate, present, view, discuss and exit are evidenced. A cleared representative threshold between sessions can express institutional readiness.

architectural_causality.answer: Olivar approach, façade hierarchy, entrance, halls and adapted rooms sequence public arrival from landscape into either civic deliberation or cultural display.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Pristine restoration exterior and event gallery coverage dominate. The underused relation is controlled civic/cultural arrival through the same inherited threshold.

light_material_geometry.answer: Filtered Olivar light can articulate old/new material and entry depth; controlled interior light can reveal occupancy, but heritage polish without a public verb fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test public grove-to-entry diagonal, registered foyer threshold and permitted room-to-landscape reverse. Start 35 mm for sequence, 50 mm for arrival and 85 mm only with threshold context.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Confirm registration and photography, never photograph documents/QR/screens, avoid disrupting sessions or visitors, obey security and use public exterior fallback when interior access is denied.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when restored civic architecture visibly governs a present deliberative or cultural act. A façade portrait or caption-built dual use fails.

C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Visitor turns between adapted room and exit

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public/registered diagonal joining Olivar approach, civic threshold and occupied hall
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approaching, waiting and entering occupy three zones

contradictions: Stage I Alameda Sáenz Peña works received heritage authorization in March 2026, but construction start/completion and current barriers are not proven.
The canonical label combines Sáenz Peña, Domeyer and passages; one frame must select one public-space/reuse threshold rather than imply a continuous corridor.
Creative-district guides document businesses and galleries, but current operators, hours and interior photography conditions can change.
composition_questions: Can one inherited alignment, passage or courtyard threshold visibly channel a current creative/public verb while authorized streetscape works alter its edge?
Which construction barrier, vehicle, vegetation, signage or tourist crowd converts the frame into a generic Barranco lifestyle image?
Does repeating an official survey position reveal meaningful present transformation, or does the multi-street label require an invalid montage?

source_truth.answer: Sáenz Peña is a documented monumental Barranco street whose Stage I public tourism-space improvement received Ministry authorization in March 2026; Domeyer and nearby passages host documented creative uses.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Aligned historic façades, setbacks, passages, gardens/courtyards and the alameda created a residential promenade and transitions from public street to private interiors.

current_life.answer: Walking, gallery visiting, working, eating, making and construction/navigation are credible; exact businesses, works and pedestrian peaks require direct verification.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Walk, enter, browse, make, display, pause, deliver and detour are documented/credible. A temporarily closed threshold can reveal reuse or works without a crowd.

architectural_causality.answer: Street alignment, alameda, gates, passages, courtyards and reused rooms sequence public promenade into creative occupation; works may currently redirect that sequence.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Heritage elevation, lifestyle street and adaptive-reuse before/after dominate. The underused relation is a repeat-view position showing one current verb or detour caused by inherited/modified space.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa can unify heterogeneous façades and expose passage depth; lateral light can show thresholds, but colorful heritage texture without reuse causality fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Reoccupy three official/public survey positions around one selected threshold before changing focal. Start 35 mm for alignment, 50 mm for entering/detouring and 85 mm only if passage depth remains.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify works and business status, remain outside barriers/private courtyards, request interior permission, avoid workers/residents as spectacle and kill any scene requiring multi-street montage.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when one inherited or modified public threshold visibly shapes current creative movement. Picturesque corridor, construction record or caption-joined streets fail.

A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude cars, signs and barrier dominance

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Adult enters, delivers or displays through inherited opening
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No faces, products or brand dominance

C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Pedestrian route bends around current intervention
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: No worker spectacle or generic cones

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: One public diagonal joining alameda approach, inherited passage and current use/detour
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Approaching, turning and entering occupy three zones

contradictions: CAMMP labels protection as absent while official municipal records cite national-monument declaration RDN 290-96/INC; the official declaration controls, and the catalogue field is preserved as a contradiction/data-quality issue.
CAMMP records current housing and destruction threat but does not identify a dated cause or evaluate condition; neither deterioration nor imminent demolition can be asserted.
The house is private residence, so plan/interior evidence cannot justify access or telephoto observation.
composition_questions: Can lateral entrance, property boundary and ordinary avenue movement show how the 1938 modern house still mediates privacy and arrival amid later development?
Which parked car, hedge, wall, adjacent building or private window makes the view invasive or destroys the entry sequence?
Does matching an archival public viewpoint expose a current spatial change visible from the street, or does the house remain only a heritage elevation?

source_truth.answer: Emilio Harth-Terré's 1938 private house at Aviación 500 remains recorded as housing and is officially listed as a national monument under a 1996 declaration; current physical condition is unevaluated.

original_spatial_contract.answer: Façade, lateral entrance, doorway and first-floor plan organize a modern private dwelling whose arrival and domestic rooms are protected behind a controlled street edge.

current_life.answer: Residential occupation is reported; entering, leaving, receiving and screening are credible, but occupants, routines and physical changes require non-intrusive observation.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, unlock, return, deliver, screen, maintain and pass are credible. A closed lateral entrance can carry meaningful domestic expectation without showing residents.

architectural_causality.answer: Lateral entry, recessed doorway, façade openings and property boundary mediate the shift from public avenue to private domestic sequence.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Isolated elevation and heritage thumbnail dominate. The underused relation is a repeat public viewpoint showing the entry sequence negotiating current street pressure.

light_material_geometry.answer: Lateral light can reveal recessed entry and plane hierarchy; garúa can clarify mass, but modernist geometry or deterioration speculation without inhabitation fails.

position_then_optics.answer: Test archival-match public position, lateral-entry tangent and block-context reverse view. Start 35 mm for street/house, 50 mm for entry gesture and avoid 85 mm if it risks window surveillance.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Remain on public pavement, never photograph into windows or wait on occupants, avoid address/security detail, do not claim demolition, and kill any proof requiring private access.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: Passes when a protected modern entry device visibly shapes current residential/street movement. Heritage elevation, threat narrative or invasive domestic observation fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Archival-match public viewpoint holding façade, lateral entrance and current block edge
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude plates, windows and parked cars

B_HABITAR.position: Public sidewalk with lateral entrance visible obliquely
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Consenting/anonymous adult enters or delivery pauses at boundary
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: No face, key, package or interior detail

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Public lateral reverse view showing house against changed avenue/block fabric
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Walker crosses between house boundary and later development

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Public oblique compressing entry recess, wall plane and sidewalk shadow

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Public diagonal joining avenue approach, protected boundary and lateral domestic entrance
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Passing, pausing and entering occupy distinct zones
